---
title: "Chronic Conditions"
subtitle: "Prevalence, multimorbidity, and income gradients"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "docs/assets")
from portal_helpers import load, fig_defaults, kpi_row, data_note, COLORS
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

data = load("chronic")
```

Chronic conditions are a major driver of healthcare utilisation and quality of life.
This section examines the prevalence of eight conditions measured in the CanHealth 2024 survey,
their concentration by age group, and the gradient with household income.

---

::: {.section-header}
## Overall prevalence
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
overall = sorted(data["overall"], key=lambda r: r["prevalence"], reverse=True)
labels  = [r["condition"] for r in overall]
vals    = [r["prevalence"] for r in overall]
bar_colors = [
    COLORS["danger"] if v > 20 else
    COLORS["warning"] if v > 10 else
    COLORS["primary"]
    for v in vals
]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=vals, y=labels,
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=bar_colors,
    text=[f"{v}%" for v in vals],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Prevalence (% of respondents)",
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
)
fig_defaults(fig, "Chronic Condition Prevalence — All Ages", height=420).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## Prevalence by age group
*Select a condition in the dropdown*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
by_age_df = pd.DataFrame(data["by_age"])
conditions = by_age_df["condition"].unique().tolist()
age_groups = sorted(by_age_df["age_group"].unique().tolist())

# Build one trace per condition, only first is visible
fig = go.Figure()
for i, cond in enumerate(conditions):
    subset = by_age_df[by_age_df["condition"] == cond]
    vals = []
    for ag in age_groups:
        row = subset[subset["age_group"] == ag]
        vals.append(float(row["prevalence"].values[0]) if len(row) else 0)
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        name=cond,
        x=age_groups,
        y=vals,
        marker_color=COLORS["primary"],
        visible=(i == 0),
        hovertemplate=f"{cond}: %{{y:.1f}}%<extra></extra>",
    ))

# Dropdown menu
buttons = [
    dict(
        label=cond,
        method="update",
        args=[
            {"visible": [j == i for j in range(len(conditions))]},
            {"title": f"{cond} — Prevalence by Age Group"},
        ],
    )
    for i, cond in enumerate(conditions)
]

fig.update_layout(
    updatemenus=[dict(
        type="dropdown",
        direction="down",
        x=0.01, xanchor="left", y=1.15,
        showactive=True,
        buttons=buttons,
    )],
    yaxis_title="Prevalence (%)",
    xaxis_title="Age group",
)
fig_defaults(fig, f"{conditions[0]} — Prevalence by Age Group", height=430).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## Multimorbidity
*The number of concurrent chronic conditions per respondent*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
multi = pd.DataFrame(data["multimorbidity"])
fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=multi["chronic_count"].astype(str) + " condition(s)",
    y=multi["pct"],
    marker_color=[
        COLORS["success"] if n == 0 else
        COLORS["primary"] if n == 1 else
        COLORS["warning"] if n <= 3 else
        COLORS["danger"]
        for n in multi["chronic_count"]
    ],
    text=[f"{p}%" for p in multi["pct"]],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="Count: %{x}, %{y:.1f}% of respondents<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="% of respondents", xaxis_title="Number of chronic conditions")
fig_defaults(fig, "Distribution of Multimorbidity", height=380).show()
```

::: {.stat-callout}
**`{python} next(r['pct'] for r in data['multimorbidity'] if r['chronic_count'] == 0)`%**
of respondents report *no* chronic conditions. Among those with at least one condition,
concurrent diagnoses (multimorbidity) are common.
:::

::: {.section-header}
## Income gradient in chronic disease burden
*Statistical test: χ² independence test (pingouin)*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
chi2 = data["chi2_income"]
print(f"χ²({chi2['chi2']:.3f}), p = {chi2['p_value']:.4f}, Cramér's V = {chi2['cramers_v']:.3f}")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import display, HTML
cramer = data["chi2_income"]["cramers_v"]
p_val  = data["chi2_income"]["p_value"]
sig    = "statistically significant" if p_val < 0.05 else "not statistically significant"
display(HTML(f"""
<div class="stat-callout">
  The association between income bracket and having at least one chronic condition
  is <strong>{sig}</strong> (p = {p_val:.4f}).
  Cramér's V = <strong>{cramer:.3f}</strong> indicates a
  {'small-to-moderate' if cramer < 0.3 else 'moderate-to-strong'} effect size.
</div>"""))
```
